title: Strong emergence meets exclusion, weak emergence meets the gap

statements.text: Strong emergentist panpsychism adds basic laws for systems-level consciousness and so faces the causal exclusion problem of dualism. Weak emergentist panpsychism adds no laws and so faces the explanatory gap of physicalism. If both hold, panpsychism seems to make no advance.

sources.quote: the strong emergentist panpsychist faces the causal exclusion problem endured by dualism, whilst the weak emergentist panpsychist faces the explanatory gap problem suffered by physicalism
